newsitem.title: USA: Thomson Financial sees $10 mln a year in Web revs.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Financial sees $10 mln a year in Web revs.

text.p: Thomson Financial Services, a subsidiary of Toronto-based Thomson Corp, said Thursday it expected its MarketEdge site on the Internet's World Wide Web would soon generate up to $10 million in revenue annually.

"Right now it's doing about $1 million or $2 million," said Thomson Financial Services President and Chief Executive Officer Mason Slaine. "But we see it going to potentially $10 million," he said, referring to MarketEdge, a version of Thomson Financial Services available to the individual investor.
MarketEdge is already available on Compuserve. It can be reached on the Web at http://www.marketedge.com.
"It markets for about $9.95 a month, and I have very high hopes for it," Slaine said.

The site provides individual investors with a variety of Thomson data, including insider holdings, institutional holdings, First Call earnings estimates, as well as quotes on stocks, mutual funds and municipal bonds. But investors are not able to trade on the site.
